name: Delaware
agency: Delaware Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV), Department of Transportation
permitAge: 16 (GDL Level One Learner's Permit, ages 16 to 17; 16 to 21 with an active IEP), after a certified Delaware driver education course (manual p. 28)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, 10 of them at night, certified by the sponsor after the first 6 months (manual p. 29)
teen.holdPermit: 12-month GDL program; the Level One permit converts to a Class D license after 12 months of valid driving authority; first 6 months supervised at all times (manual pp. 29-30)
teen.nightLimit: After the first 6 months: may drive alone 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.; 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. only supervised, except going directly to and from church, work, or school activities on school property (manual p. 30)
teen.passengerLimit: For the whole 12 months: only the adult supervisor and one other passenger; immediate family is exempt when the adult supervisor is in the car; driving alone, only one passenger (manual pp. 29-30)
teen.phone: All drivers: no hand-held phone or texting; adults may use hands-free. GDL drivers may not use any phone or electronic device, including hands-free (manual pp. 29, 81)

bac.under21: 0.02: zero tolerance, license revoked (manual p. 50; p. 54)

notes: Handbook: Delaware Driver Manual, July 2026 edition (cover dated July 2026; PDF created June 2026), 152 pages; printed page numbers match PDF page numbers. Spanish manual: 2025 edition (Spanish_manual_LR.pdf). DMV also posts Chinese, Haitian Creole and Korean manuals (forms page).

Knowledge test: the DMV written-exam page says the Class D knowledge test has 32 questions and 26 must be correct to pass (https://dmv.de.gov/DriverServices/drivers_license/index.shtml?dc=dr_lic_written). It has a sign-and-signal part and a rules-of-the-road part (manual p. 41).
Test languages: neither the manual nor the DMV pages checked say which languages the knowledge test is offered in, so exam.spanish stays null.

Supervisor: licensed parent, guardian, or a licensed driver approved by the sponsor who is at least 25 and has held a Class D license at least 5 years, in the front seat; no one else in the front seat (manual p. 29).
GDL is optional at 18 or older. Adult first-time learner's permit: supervisor must be at least 21; road test no sooner than 30 days after the knowledge test (manual p. 30).
Violating Level One restrictions counts as driving without a license: 2-month suspension first offense, 4 months after (manual p. 30).
Move over law on manual p. 82. dmv.de.gov rejects requests without full browser headers (F5 'Request Rejected').
